title: ID0424337-DC/Si-D/FR[170002001] - Outlet is offline, comm outage: 5001 ms
description:
Reported error:
2025-05-14T06:55:24.012626+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] ecog-secc-adapter/274bc502de4b[734]: Outlet is offline, comm outage: 5001 ms
Solution: Install EcoG 1.4.12

additional_info.subject: New Issue on Connector DC2 – Charging Station S/N: MP/R6 170002001
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I hope this message finds you well.
I would like to report a new issue concerning
Connector DC2
of the charging station with
serial number MP/R6 170002001
. The connector showed a status of
"Unavailable"
on
May 14, 2025
, between
09:40:22 and 09:47:19
.
Please note that a previous ticket had already been submitted last week for this same charging station under the following reference:
TR:
ID0423937-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/R6 170002001]
CRM:
02681000157
Could you kindly investigate this new occurrence and let us know whether it is related to the prior incident? We would appreciate your insights on the root cause and any corrective actions needed to prevent recurrence.
Thank you for your support.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485

additional_info.subject: ID0424337-DC/Si-D/FR[170002001] - DC2 session abortion CRM:00315002645
additional_info.body:
Dear Malek,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R6 170002001
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
4HIbKg
Problem Description
: DC2 session abortion
Troubleshooting
: I found the issue. It's related to the new hotfix for the wake-up function (BCB toggle). I was discovered that there is a bug in this hotfix and it's fixed already with a newer version of the SECC. If I have your permission, I will install it as soon as no one is charging.
If the error reappears, then we need to send the field technicians for a deep troubleshoot and solution.
For future reference, your case number is
0424337
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
